verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API and personal access tokens let custom tools update pages, databases and properties, so a designer could build a design-tool plugin that pushes status into Notion. The documented design integrations (Sketch, Canva) only embed and view designs inside Notion, which is the opposite direction from this story. missing for 10: a native or marketplace design-tool plugin that updates Notion project status from inside the design tool, documentation of such a workflow, and hands-on corroboration.
